test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the new upper limit for no personal income tax payable under the new tax regime as per Union Budget 2025–26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹12 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During the presentation of the **Union Budget 2025–26** on **February 1, 2025**, Union Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman** announced significant changes to the personal income tax structure under the **New Tax Regime**.
 
• The most notable highlight is that no personal income tax will be payable by individuals with an annual income of up to **₹12 lakh** under the **New Tax Regime**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the ₹12 lakh limit is correct.***
 
• This tax-free status for income up to **₹12 lakh** is made possible by a combination of revised **tax slabs**, an increased **tax rebate** under **Section 87A**, and an enhanced **standard deduction**.
 
• The **standard deduction** for salaried employees and pensioners opting for the **New Tax Regime** has been increased from **₹75,000** to ₹1,00,
